title: Variations in neuronal cytoskeletal integrity affect directed communication in distributed networks during inhibitory control
summary: The neural-network connectivity estimator nCREANN analyzed EEG-derived directed communication; its measures were associated with neurofilament markers during inhibitory-control tasks.
ai_technology: nCREANN, an artificial-neural-network estimator, was applied to EEG-derived source signals to estimate nonlinear directed connectivity.
organization: Cognitive Neurophysiology; University Hospital Carl Gustav Carus

evidence.tested: The neural-network connectivity estimator nCREANN analyzed EEG-derived directed communication; its measures were associated with neurofilament markers during inhibitory-control tasks.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the reported dataset, experimental setting and validation in this study; broader generalization and real-world benefit are not established.
